newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian official reserves fall in May.
newsitem.headline: Australian official reserves fall in May.

text.p: Australia's holdings of gold and foreign exchange assets fell to US$16.975 billion in May from US$17.367 billion in April, compared with US$14.280 billion in May 1996, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
In Australian dollar terms, reserves rose by A$64 million to A$22.30 billion in May from A$22.23 billion in April compared with A$17.888 billion a year earlier, the bank said.
The bank said its transactions, mainly swaps, resulted in a fall in Australian dollar reserves but this was more than offset by revaluation effects.
